requirements.evidence: User requested a new 1.65 GHz rectangular patch antenna CST project for review, with no simulation.

reference_checked.finding: The user request defines review-gated output and forbids simulation.

requirements.pass_condition: Task type, output expectation, review-gated mode, frequency intent, and no-simulation instruction are recorded.
requirements.unchecked_risk: Antenna performance remains unchecked until simulation is allowed.

physical_structure.evidence: Structure brief records microstrip-fed rectangular patch on grounded dielectric substrate with radiation normal to top metal.

reference_checked.finding: The Help topic identifies microstrip as a field-bearing transmission-line structure requiring the relevant field region to be modeled.

physical_structure.pass_condition: Layer stack, conductors, feed topology, propagation direction, and boundary meaning are recorded.
physical_structure.unchecked_risk: No field/current inspection because no solver was run.

parameterization.evidence: CST parameters and History entries define units, substrate height, patch dimensions, feed width, frequency range, and derived coordinates.

reference_checked.finding: Units and reusable dimensions are checked before commands reference them.

parameterization.pass_condition: Reusable dimensions are CST parameters before History commands reference them.
parameterization.unchecked_risk: Manual edits after validation require rerunning this ledger.

materials.evidence: CST material list contains dielectric substrate material and conductor material used by expected solids.

reference_checked.finding: Material properties and assignments are checked against CST material-help semantics and the structure brief.

materials.pass_condition: Dielectric, conductor, and background material assignments match the structure brief.
materials.unchecked_risk: Material loss impact is not quantified without simulation.

geometry_connectivity.evidence: Geometry inventory shows substrate, continuous ground, patch metal, inset region, and feed line with intended contact to patch.

reference_checked.topic: Solid creation, Boolean operations, and object inventory
reference_checked.finding: Geometry and connectivity checks are based on CST object and Boolean semantics before port creation.

geometry_connectivity.pass_condition: Expected solids exist; signal path continuity, ground continuity, layer heights, and intended clearances are recorded.
geometry_connectivity.unchecked_risk: No meshed contact or current-flow evidence because no solver was run.

port.evidence: Port record declares waveguide Port on the feed transverse cross-section, with dimensions derived from CST Help and signal-to-ground mode line.

port.pass_condition: The declared feed uses a CST port object and port dimensions supported by the checked Help/macro source for that feed.
port.unchecked_risk: No port-mode solve; modal impedance and field quality are unchecked.
